jobs.job_description:
Job Description GenAI / LLM Engineer

Experience: 2–8 Years
Work Locations:  Kolkata


We are looking for skilled and passionate GenAI Engineers with strong experience in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI frameworks, and Python development. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience building scalable AI applications, integrating LLMs into enterprise workflows, and developing intelligent autonomous systems.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy GenAI applications using LLMs and Agentic AI frameworks.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines using vector databases and embedding models.
Develop AI-powered chatbots, copilots, assistants, and workflow automation solutions.
Integrate foundation models such as GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, or similar into enterprise systems.
Work on prompt engineering, fine-tuning, evaluation, and model optimization.
Develop APIs and backend services using Python.
Collaborate with data engineering, cloud, and product teams for scalable deployments.
Implement monitoring, guardrails, and performance tuning for GenAI applications.
Stay updated with advancements in GenAI, autonomous agents, and AI tooling ecosystems.



Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in Python programming.
Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and GenAI ecosystems.
Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector search, and semantic retrieval.
Experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar.
Hands-on experience with vector databases like Pinecone, ChromaDB, FAISS, Weaviate, or Milvus.
Experience in prompt engineering and LLM orchestration.
Familiarity with REST APIs, microservices, and cloud platforms.
Good understanding of AI application deployment and scalability.
jobs.ai_reason: Strong production RAG, LangGraph, FastAPI, AWS experience; transferable skills cover Azure OpenAI; meets core requirements.
